newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Daewoo raises investment in Morocco to $900 mln.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo raises investment in Morocco to $900 mln.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp will increase its investments in Morocco to $900 million from the $500 million decided last July, a Moroccan finance ministry official said on Tuesday.
The additional $400 million would be invested mainly in the car industry. "The global accord could be signed early April," he added.
An agreement of principle was signed last July covering telecommunications, tourism and electronics.

Daewoo bought the five-star Hyatt Regency Hotel in Rabat for $28.7 million in December last year. A change of management to Hilton Hotels Corp will be finalised on March 12 and the hotel's name changed accordingly.
Under the deal, Daewoo will invest $53 million to renovate the hotel over two years.
